camel_example:
aliyun cloudauth DeepfakeDetect --region cn-hangzhou --FaceAttributeCheck Y --FaceBase64 '/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASxxxxxxx
' --FaceInputType IMAGE --OuterOrderNo 'e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c******' --FaceUrl 'https://cn-shanghai-aliyun-cloudauth-xxxxxx.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/verify/xxxxx/xxxxx.jpeg'
description_en: Detects deepfake risks in facial images by using algorithms, covering risk scenarios such as AI-generated content (AIGC) faces, deepfake face swaps, template faces, and recaptured faces, and outputs risk tags and confidence levels
description_zh: 传入人脸图片，通过算法检测是否存在深度伪造风险。包含AIGC生成人脸、深度伪造换脸、模板人脸、翻拍人脸等风险场景，输出风险标签与置信度
name: DeepfakeDetect

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character alphanumeric string. The first few characters consist of a custom abbreviation defined by the merchant, the middle part can contain a time period, and the latter part can be a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh: 商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列
parameters.name: outer_order_no

parameters.help_en:
The input type of the facial material. Valid values:

IMAGE (default): facial image.
VIDEO: facial video.

Video processing takes a long time. Set the timeout period to greater than 3 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
人脸素材输入类型：

IMAGE（默认）：人脸图片
VIDEO：人脸视频

视频处理时间较久，建议超时时间设置>3S
parameters.name: face_input_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the facial image.
You must specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64
parameters.help_zh:
传入人脸图片URL地址。
FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个
parameters.name: face_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of the facial image.
You must specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64
parameters.help_zh:
传入人脸图片的Base64格式编码。
FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个
parameters.name: face_base64

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable facial attribute detection
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启人脸属性检测
parameters.name: face_attribute_check

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success, and other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

Result.description_en:
The risk result. Valid values:

0: low risk.
1: high risk.
2: suspicious
Result.description_zh:
风险结果：

0：低风险
1：高风险
2：可疑

additionalProperties.description_en: The risk score tags and their scores
additionalProperties.description_zh: 风险分值标签及其分值

RiskTag.description_en:
The risk tags. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

SuspectDeepForgery: suspected deepfake.
SuspectPSFace: suspected synthetic attack.
SuspectTemple: suspected black market attack.
SuspectRemake: suspected recaptured face
RiskTag.description_zh:
风险标签。多个标签使用半角逗号（,）隔开，包括：

疑似深度伪造  SuspectDeepForgery
疑似合成攻击  SuspectPSFace
疑似黑产攻击  SuspectTemple
疑似翻拍人脸  SuspectRemake
